senses.gloss: m. (b. h.) a veiled or withered spot in the eye, cataract. Sifra Emor ch. II, Par. 3 דק זה הדוק the Biblical daḳ is what is now called doḳ.
units: <cite ref="Bekhorot 38b:3">Bekh. 38ᵇ</cite> <he>דוק שחור</he> a black spot, <he>ד׳ לבן</he> a white spot.—Pl. <he>דּוֹקִין</he>.
<cite ref="Gittin 56a">Gitt. 56ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 51a">Ab. Zar. 51ᵃ</cite> <he>ד׳ שכעין</he>; a. e.—V. <cite ref="D00328"><he>דּוּקָא</he> II</cite>.
